lines: 90.pdf, scans 002,010; 91.pdf, scans 008–009
statement: Let R=k[t]_(t), K=k(t), and take the open subgroup G=Spec(R)⊔Spec(K) of the constant two-element group over Spec(R), retaining the whole identity component and only the generic point of the other component.
